extension.description: Experimental engineering builds; not the stable tester channel. Install Shadow from this repository to establish its update origin. Installation is independent of future licence activation.

SHK-004 dev.1 Kodi 21 adaptation candidate: five-icon controller dock, Continue Watching spotlight, favourite channels and saved-provider restoration using existing remembered permission choices. Retains the .57 playback and account baseline for approved live channels, Movies and TV Series. Credential-isolating revocable local playback relay; verified HTTPS or explicitly approved HTTP connection choices. Account-scoped Watch Later, resume history, watched controls, tolerant local search, recently discovered titles and personal backup/restore. Provider programme guide, Now/Next progress, public artwork and overview fallbacks. Optional next-episode prompts and cancellable autoplay, disabled by default. Optional unencrypted local login storage and remembered connection permissions. Synthetic local playback tests included. Native Xbox acceptance remains required.
